title: Feeling good about your country
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
What makes you feel proud of your country, if anything?
Can national pride be positive without becoming nationalism?
Should people openly criticise their country even when speaking to foreigners?
Do sporting events create genuine national unity or only temporary emotion?
What is one thing your country does well that you think deserves more recognition?
